analysis_method.condition_ci: two-sided Student-t interval for the episode mean; sample standard deviation uses ddof=1
analysis_method.effect_size: paired Cohen dz: mean within-pair score difference divided by its sample standard deviation
analysis_method.equivalence_testing: omitted; no independently justified, pre-registered margin
analysis_method.p_value_correction: Holm step-down family-wise correction across every pairwise condition comparison
analysis_method.paired_ci: percentile paired bootstrap interval for the mean score difference, resampling matched episode pairs
analysis_method.paired_test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test of the mean difference under within-pair exchangeability

astra_historical_4000_note.text: Astra's 4,000-episode local historical result includes an additional group 300. This matched comparison uses only groups 42, 100, and 200 (3,000 episodes). The paper's published 1,000-episode result is a separate sample and is not substituted here.
